'''Zhou Qifeng''' ({{lang-zh|s=周其凤}}; born October 1947) is a Chinese chemist and academician who formerly served as 10th [[President of Peking University|President]] of [[Peking University]] from 2008 to 2013.<ref name="PU">[http://www.pku.edu.cn/about/ldjg/xzh/zqf.jsp 北京大学网站：周其凤 北京大学党委常委、校长] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100729151738/http://www.pku.edu.cn/about/ldjg/xzh/zqf.jsp |date=July 29, 2010 }}</ref> He currently serves as Professor of Polymer Science and Engineering in the College of Chemistry and Molecular Engineering at Peking University. He is also a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

At Peking, in 1995, he became executive vice-dean of the graduate school of Peking University and later as vice-provost of Peking University until 2001.<ref name="PU" />{{better source needed|date=January 2024|reason=Source has details of positions, but doesng have the dates mentioned in the text}}

He was president of the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]] (IUPAC) between 2018 and 2019<ref>{{cite web |title=Past Officers |url=https://iupac.org/who-we-are/our-leadership/past-officers/ |website=International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry}}</ref> and member of [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="PU" /> He is also a deputy of [[National People's Congress]] of the [[People’s Republic of China]].<ref>{{cite web |title=IARU - IARU Presidents |url=https://archiv.iaru.ethz.ch/about/presidents.html |website=archiv.iaru.ethz.ch}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Zhou Qifeng was an undergraduate student in Peking University from 1965 to 1970, and became a faculty member immediately after his graduation in 1970.<ref name="PU" /> He studied at [[University of Massachusetts Amherst]] and received an [[Master of Science|M.S.]] in 1981 and [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in 1983.<ref name="PU" /> In 2010, he received an honorary [[Doctor of Science]] from the University of Massachusetts Amherst.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zhou Qifeng received 2010 honorary degree |url=https://www.pse.umass.edu/events/zhou-qifeng-received-2010-honorary-degree |publisher=[[University of Massachusetts Amherst]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240709015710/https://www.pse.umass.edu/events/zhou-qifeng-received-2010-honorary-degree |accessdate=July 9, 2024|archive-date=9 July 2024 }}</ref>

He was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1999.<ref name="PU" />

==Books, research papers and journals==
He has published a few internationally books and over 200 papers. Zhou has received many honors for both teaching and research.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Zhou Qifeng - Academician of Chinese Academy of Sciences |url=https://www.wise-qatar.org/biography/zhou-qifeng/ |publisher=World Innovation Summit for Education|accessdate=October 9, 2024 }}</ref>
